description:
Recently renovated to a high standard, this spacious two double bedroom first-floor apartment is located in a quiet cul-de-sac with south-facing views over the popular village of Wetheral, on the eastern fringe of the city.

The accommodation comprises a living dining room, modern fitted kitchen, and shower room. The property also features a private low-maintenance garden, garage, and driveway, adding convenience and charm to this attractive home.

Wetheral is a sought-after village offering a range of amenities, including a public house, hotel with a restaurant, gym, spa, Fantails restaurant, and a train station on the Carlisle to Newcastle line.

Ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors looking to enter the buy-to-let market. Don't miss out on this opportunity to own a stylish and well-appointed apartment in a desirable location. Contact us today to schedule a viewing.

Directions From Carlisle, head east on the A69 heading towards Warwick Bridge and Brampton. Before entering Warwick-On-Eden turn right on Plains Road heading to Wetheral. At the junction at the end of Plains Road turn right onto Steele's Bank. Take the second right back towards Scotby / Carlisle. Turn left onto Goose Garth.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
